name: Cash+
description: Your investment earns interest and a share of business conversion fees.
previewNotice: Preview data is illustrative. Connect a configured demo deployment to execute real transactions.
forkNotice: This demonstration runs on a local fork. Transactions use test funds and the counterparty is a demo participant.
stale: The latest read is unavailable. These are the last observed values; refresh before investing.
errorBody: Your assets are unchanged. Try refreshing the connection to the selected network.

position.title: My investment
position.emptyTitle: One investment. Two sources of return.
position.emptyBody: Eligible capital earns lending interest. Business conversions add a margin to the pool, within defined limits.
position.emptyHint: Start with USDC. Follow everything here.
position.accounting: Values are denominated in USDC. Dollar figures assume USDC equals $1.
position.liquidity: Subject to a fresh transaction simulation. Lending balances are not a cash guarantee.

chart.title: Value of 100 USDC
chart.emptyTitle: A little more history is needed
chart.emptyBody: The chart will appear after at least two observed checkpoints. No annual yield is inferred from this demo.
chart.label: Observed value of an initial 100 USDC, normalized across checkpoints

invest.title: Invest in Cash+
invest.subtitle: Let your USDC do more.
invest.hint: Review the amount before your wallet opens.
invest.full: The pool is at capacity. Withdrawals remain available.
invest.unreadBalance: Wallet balance is unavailable. Refresh to use Max.
invest.invalid: Enter a positive amount with up to 6 decimal places.
invest.overBalance: This amount exceeds your available wallet balance.
invest.overCapacity: This amount exceeds the available pool capacity.
invest.belowMinimum: This amount is below the minimum investment.
invest.proportionalHelp: An alternative exit: receive your share of each asset, which may include lending receipt tokens.
invest.cashLimited: Cash liquidity is limited. Review a smaller amount or receive the pool's assets.

sources.title: Where returns come from
sources.interestHint: Aave interest accrued, valued at current token prices
sources.partial: The return breakdown is incomplete. Total investment result remains separate from these pool-wide figures.

flow.title: Your money, working together
flow.subtitle: A simple investment. The work happens behind the scenes.
flow.interestBody: Eligible idle capital earns lending interest.
flow.convertBody: Businesses exchange stablecoins within the pool's limits.
flow.earnBody: Conversion margins remain in the pool's value.

activity.title: Pool activity
activity.subtitle: Deposits, placements, conversions and withdrawals.
activity.partial: Recent history only. Earlier events are outside this read window.
activity.localReceipt: Local fork receipt. This transaction will not appear on a public explorer.

details.compositionHint: Underlying assets, counted once across the wallet and lending.
details.title: Investment details
details.feesBody: This contract version charges no management or performance fee. Trading costs affect actual pool balances. The comparison below includes a separate illustrative commercial fee.
details.liquidityBody: USDC withdrawals depend on current pool and lending liquidity. A proportional exit returns the pool's assets and may include receipt tokens with separate redemption limits.
details.riskBody: Returns vary and losses are possible. Stablecoins can lose value. Smart contracts, lending protocols, price feeds and available liquidity introduce risks.

simulation.title: What could a year look like?
simulation.label: Illustrative comparison
simulation.description: Explore the assumptions. This calculator does not change your investment or the observed results above.
simulation.disclaimer: Annual simple illustration, before taxes, individual funding and exit costs, and extraordinary losses. Volume is an assumption, not demonstrated customer demand. Outperformance is not guaranteed.
simulation.invalid: Check the assumptions. Values must be non-negative and percentages cannot exceed 100%.

transaction.reviewBody: Check the amounts and network before continuing.
transaction.approvalBody: Only the exact investment amount is approved to the Cash+ vault.
transaction.signatureBody: Your wallet will show the transaction for you to confirm.
transaction.pendingBody: Waiting for an onchain receipt. Closing this sheet does not cancel the transaction. Do not submit it again.
transaction.successBody: The receipt is confirmed. Your investment is being refreshed from the chain.
transaction.noCash: This exit returns assets, not a single USDC payment. Lending receipt tokens may require a separate withdrawal when liquidity is available.
transaction.previewOnly: Preview only. Real wallet transactions are disabled in this illustrative environment.
transaction.rejected: You declined the wallet request. Your funds have not moved.
transaction.changed: Your wallet, network or reviewed quote changed. Return and review again.
transaction.liquidity: There is not enough immediately available USDC for this withdrawal. Try a smaller amount or a proportional exit.
transaction.generic: The transaction could not continue. Refresh the state and review again.
transaction.read: Current chain data is unavailable. Refresh before trying again.
transaction.gas: Your wallet needs more native network tokens to pay the transaction fee.
transaction.oracle: Price checks are unavailable. Priced transactions are paused.
transaction.reverted: The transaction reverted onchain. No investment or withdrawal was completed.
transaction.timeout: Confirmation is taking longer than expected. Keep this transaction hash and refresh; do not submit again.

demo.title: Demo evidence
demo.body: Investment, lending placement, conversion and withdrawal are separate onchain steps. Presenter actions run in the local CLI; this page reads their results.
demo.next: Next scene: run the keeper or counterparty script, then refresh to inspect the confirmed change.
demo.time: Fork time can be advanced during rehearsal. Any resulting interest is a time-advanced test, not yield earned in real presentation time.
